page.notes: Greek lines are uncertain at several points (marked [?]). The large initial L is joined to the word "Abeo", read as Labeo. "Latini sermonis" has a long s, copied as s. Printed letters as on the scan: "Lyfia", "Lyfides", "Macedonici" and "Actu" are read from the print. The line "24.224.29.225.3.5" is a continuation of the Maccabees entry and its numbers are uncertain. Small dashes and dots beside some entries (for example before "Lucilij" and after "Arri-dæus") are printer's marks, not text. No marginal notes are printed on this part.
